correctness.rationale: Exact degree-wise flip condition: at degree d with t same-bit neighbors, closed minority flips iff 2t>=d, changing the number of same edges by d−2t. For all recurrent states leaf edges disagree; degree-three marked vertices cannot flip at constant energy. A pair in one arc or adjacent arcs can be moved to an energy-decreasing collision. Otherwise the one-or-zero particles in nonconsecutive arcs are closed reflecting walks. Cycle parity forces |I|≡n mod 2; binary complement yields two components. The weighted count and exact tensor-product path Laplacian spectrum follow. Actual packaged class_scc.py exhaustively verified 243 graphs and 335632 configurations, and class_product.py checked 32 independent constructed cases and path eigenvectors. These finite checks supplement the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A natural unicyclic graph with selectable one-leaf pinning sites supports complete higher-energy persistent-frustration sectors. The cycle parity constraint yields a Lucas-plus-period-six number of attractors depending only on the number of marks, even though sizes and mixing rates distinguish their placement. In particular an even 12-cycle with marks 0,2,5,7 has nonabsorbing 2-particle recurrent components of sizes 4 and 15 despite admitting bipartite ground states. This is a motivated full infinite-family dynamical classification and exact relaxation law, beyond the already known matching/Lucas counts.
